meta.title: Qarṭaǧ tedder di Tunisia
meta.desc: Tamdint n Elisa d Hanibal i d-yefkan i Tunisia lmulk-is amezwaru ameqqran, tefka i ddunit isem n Afrika s yiman-is.
hero.title: Qarṭaǧ tedder di Tunisia
hero.lede: Tamdint n Elisa d Hanibal i d-yefkan i Tunisia lmulk-is amezwaru ameqqran, tefka i ddunit isem n Afrika s yiman-is.
hero.caption: Tiɣilt n Byrsa d lxalij n Tunes — amḍiq n UNESCO seg 1979
names.title: Yiwen n yisem, ukuz n tutlayin
names.items.0.text: Tafiniqit-tapunit : « Tamdint tamaynut ». D isem-is amezwaru, ɣer 814 send Ɛisa.
names.items.1.text: Isem agrikan, yettwaseqdacen sɣur Polybe d yimeskaren ihelinistiyen.
names.items.2.text: Talatinit, syen i d-kkan Carthage, Carthagène d Cartagena.
names.items.3.text: Taɛrabt : ass-a d taɣiwant deg ugmar agafa n Tunes.
africa.kicker: Seg wanda i d-yekka wawal « Afrika » ?
africa.title: Afrika tlul-d di Tunisia
africa.rows.0.val: Iṛumaniyen semman-asen Afri i yimezdaɣ n tamnaḍt n Qarṭaǧ.
africa.rows.1.val: Mbeɛd uɣelli n Qarṭaǧ, Ṛuma tesnulfa-d tamnaḍt n Africa, i d-yemṣadan d ugafa-usamer n Tunisia n wussan-a.
africa.rows.2.val: Isem yuɣal-d إفريقية Ifriqiya, s Lqayrawan d tamanaɣt : Tunisia d tmura i s-yezzin.
africa.rows.3.val: Isem n tamnaḍt tatunsiyt yettusemma i umur ameqqran n ddunit, yesɛan 54 n tmura.
africa.note: Azal n wawal Afri mazal-it d amseqsi : llan wid i d-yeqqaren d awal amaziɣ ifri (« axxam deg wedrar »), wiyaḍ d afiniqi ʿafar (« aɣebbaṛ »), neɣ d isem n ɛerc.
africa.caption: Lqayrawan, tamanaɣt n Ifriqiya — Tajamaɛt Tameqqrant (lqern wis 7–9)
today.title: Isem Qarṭaǧ ass-a
today.aside: Sin uɛecrin lqern mbeɛd 146 send Ɛisa, isem-agi mazal-it d acaraf n Tunisia.

today.items.2.name: Ussan n usinima n Qarṭaǧ
today.items.2.text: Tafaska n usinima taqburt akteṛ di Afrika d ddunit taɛrabt.
today.items.3.name: Tafaska tagraɣlant n Qarṭaǧ
today.items.3.text: Yal anebdu, deg umeskan aqdim n Qarṭaǧ.

today.items.4.text: Isem n lɛáb n tkurt n uḍar n tmurt.

today.items.5.text: Yiwet seg tsedwiyin tameqqranin tagdudanin n tmurt.

today.items.6.text: Tamlilit tameqqrant n umeskan aɛrabi d ufriqi.
today.items.7.text: imukan Tunsiyen yettwajerben ɣer UNESCO, gar-asen Qarṭaǧ, Kerkuan, Dugga d Lqayrawan.

town.title: Qarṭaǧ, tamdint n wass-a
town.aside: Taɣiwant n Tunes Tameqqrant anda zedɣen aṭas n medden, yebnan ger lqaɛa n tqedmiwin.
town.stats.0.t: imezdaɣ di useddi n 2014 (Lmaɛhad agdudan n ustat).
town.stats.1.t: taɣiwant tettwasnulfa-d s lqanun n lbaylik n 15 yunyu.
town.stats.2.t: tiɣiwanin : Qarṭaǧ, Qarṭaǧ-Mohamed Ali (yettwasnulfan 1983) akked El Yasmina.
town.stats.3.t: seg wammas n Tunes, s waṣṣaɣen n 3 km n lebḥer ɣef lxalij, ger Le Kram ɣer usamer d Sidi Bou Said ɣer ugafa.
town.quarters.title: Lḥarat
town.quarters.rows.0.val: Ɣer lmiraṣi tipunit akked tofet. Aɣlif Mustapha Khaznadar yebna din lqṣer amezwaru n unebdu deg lqern wis 19 ; Lmaɛhad agdudan n tussniwin d tseɣnaset n lebḥer (1924) yesɛa din asidag-ines n lebḥer.
town.quarters.rows.1.val: Tiɣilt n umezruy : asidag agdawan n Qarṭaǧ, Acropolium (takaṭidrat taqburt) akked lḥara tapunit.
town.quarters.rows.2.val: Ɣer lqṣer uprezidan ; Le Corbusier yebna din tawwurt (villa) Baizeau (1928-1929), alisi n Qarṭaǧ-Prezidans yebda seg 1952.
town.quarters.rows.3.val: Snat tudrin timecṭuḥin n ifellaḥen i yellan send lqern wis 19 ; yella din umeskan aṛumani d tɣebbarin timeqqranin n waman.
town.quarters.rows.4.val: Tiɣsar n TGM akked lḥarat n uzdeɣ ; sin ineggura sɛan ismawen n yiqarṭaǧiyen imeqqranen.
town.quarters.rows.5.val: Lḥarat ijdiden akteṛ, uɣalen d tiɣiwanin ticki imezdaɣ ɛeddan.
town.palace.title: Seg tawwurt tamestaɛmert ɣer lqṣer uprezidan
town.palace.paragraphs.0: Tiwwura timezwura s wammag uṛufi d-ḍherent ɣer 1906. Tin yesɛan azal ameqqran tuɣal d tin n umsekkel amatu n tnezmert tatunsiyt, aqeddac afransi aɛlayan i yeswerin s tidet lḥukuma n lḥima.
town.palace.paragraphs.1: Deg 1960, Bourguiba iga-t d lqṣer uprezidan, ɣef rrif n lebḥer, s drus n lqṣuba seg isiḥman n Antonin. Qarṭaǧ mačči d tamanaɣt, maca tuɣal d « amḍiq n tezmert yecban » (Sophie Bessis), Tunes teḥbes tnezmert d tdamsa.
town.palace.mayors: Gar imeqdimen n teɣiwant : Chedli Klibi (1963-1990) akked Fouad Mebazaa (1995-1998).
town.life.0.title: Tamdint n lmuɛassasat
town.life.0.text: Asidag agdawan (deg ixxamen iqdimen n Ibabat Imellalen), Acropolium akked tfaska-ines n Jazz à Carthage (seg 2005), Takadimit tatunsiyt Beït al-Hikma deg lqṣer Zarrouk (seg 1983), IHEC Qarṭaǧ, tajamaɛt Mâlik ibn Anas (2003, aẓeṭṭa n 55 m, ugar n 1000 n yimɛabden).
town.life.1.title: Sețța n tɣsar n TGM
town.life.1.text: Umnir TGM izegger taɣiwant, yeqqen-itt ɣer La Goulette d Tunes seg yiwen uɣanib, ɣer Sidi Bou Said d La Marsa seg wayeḍ : tiɣsar Salammbô, Byrsa, Dermech, Hannibal, Prezidans d Amilcar. Lkaṛyat n Transtu sseɛdun daɣen Ariana d Tunes.
town.life.2.title: Ixxamen, volley-ball d trail
town.life.2.text: Tamdint n uzdeɣ s telqey, ssaɣen-tt idiblumasiyen akked yiqeddacen iɛlayanen, tdder drus seg usiyaf ɣas ulamma teṭṭuqten iẖribat-is : drus n tnezduɣin, ulac rrif n lebḥer ameqqran. Ɣef uddal : Tajmaɛt n uddal n Qarṭaǧ, teṭṭuqten deg volley-ball, Aklub n tilawin n Qarṭaǧ akked, seg 2015, trail n temdint Run In Carthage, i d-yebdun seg umeskan aṛumani.
town.twins.title: Ukuz n temdinin ‘tiyetmatin'
town.twins.rows.0.val: Wayeḍ Qart Hadašt, i bnan At Barka.
town.twins.rows.3.val: tamdint tafiniqit tameqqrant anda i d-tekker Elisa.
town.peace.title: Talwit tettwazmel akked Ṛuma
town.peace.text: Imeqdimen n Ṛuma akked Qarṭaǧ, Ugo Vetere d Chedli Klibi, zemmlen tagallelt n ucaraf i yesqeḍɛen s tidet amenɣi wis krad apuni, ugar n 2100 iseggasen seg 146 send Ɛisa.
